fields.protocol_layer: Application + Data-link layer for a dedicated 2-wire DC bus. Manchester-encoded NRZ-equivalent at 1200 baud.

channels_forward_frame.name: START_BIT
channels_forward_frame.purpose: Marks the beginning of the forward frame; always logic '1' (LOW→HIGH mid-bit transition).

channels_forward_frame.name: ADDRESS_BYTE
channels_forward_frame.purpose: YAAAAAAB. Y selects short/group/broadcast/special; AAAAAA = address index; B selects direct vs indirect payload.

channels_forward_frame.name: DATA_BYTE
channels_forward_frame.purpose: Direct arc-power level (B=0) or indirect command code (B=1).

channels_forward_frame.name: STOP_FIELD
channels_forward_frame.purpose: Two stop bits — continuous HIGH for ≥ 2 × bit-time.

channels_backward_frame.name: START_BIT
channels_backward_frame.purpose: Marks the beginning of the backward frame; always logic '1'.

channels_backward_frame.name: DATA_BYTE
channels_backward_frame.purpose: QUERY result — status byte / level value / version / scene level / memory bank content.

channels_backward_frame.name: STOP_FIELD
channels_backward_frame.purpose: Two stop bits — continuous HIGH for ≥ 2 × bit-time.

channels_address_byte_decoded.name: ADDRESS_FIELD_AAAAAA
channels_address_byte_decoded.purpose: Short address index (Y=0) or group/broadcast/special index (Y=1).

channels_address_byte_decoded.name: B_BIT
channels_address_byte_decoded.purpose: Payload-type selector: 0 = direct level, 1 = indirect command.

channels_physical_options.name: DALI 2-wire DC bus (DA+/DA-)
channels_physical_options.use: Standard DALI universe — 11.5..22.5 V DC, ≤ 250 mA, polarity-insensitive.

channels_physical_options.name: Opto-isolator pair (4N137-class)
channels_physical_options.use: Galvanic isolation between bus and microcontroller — one direction each.

channels_physical_options.name: MSP430 GPIO DALI_RX (P2.0)
channels_physical_options.use: Edge-interrupt input; CPU samples Manchester bits via WDT+ timer.

channels_physical_options.name: MSP430 GPIO DALI_TX (P2.1)
channels_physical_options.use: Open-drain output through opto-isolator drives the bus LOW.

channels_physical_options.name: MSP430 Timer_A3 PWM (PWM1/PWM2)
channels_physical_options.use: 1.6 kHz PWM out to TPS62260 buck regulator EN pin → LED string current control.

global_signals.name: BUS_IDLE_STATE
global_signals.purpose: Bus passive HIGH; transmitters pull LOW.

global_signals.name: BIT_TIME
global_signals.purpose: Full bit time = 833.33 μs at 1200 baud.

global_signals.name: BYTE_ORDER
global_signals.purpose: MSB first within each byte; address byte transmitted before data byte.

dependency_graph.common_rule: DALI is single-master per bus: control device emits a 16-bit forward frame; the addressed control gear acts and (for queries) may answer with an 8-bit backward frame 7..22 TE later. There is no NACK and no general per-frame ACK. Forward frames are spaced ≥ 22 TE apart.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: DATA_BYTE meaning is dispatched by B bit of ADDRESS_BYTE; backward DATA_BYTE depends on the originating QUERY command. STORE DTR AS X commands consume the most recent DTR loaded by the special command 0xA3.

ordering_rules.frame_ordering: Address byte first, then data byte; MSB first within each byte.
ordering_rules.te_ordering: Within a Manchester bit cell, the first half holds the leading level and the mid-bit transition encodes the bit value.
ordering_rules.interframe: ≥ 22×TE between consecutive forward frames; ≥ 13.5 ms recommended.
ordering_rules.two_strike_window: ≤ 100 ms between the two deliveries of a destructive command.
